## OpenUtau Mobile 1.2.0

> **Vibe-coded with AI.** The additions in this app were written by [Claude](https://claude.com/claude-code) (Anthropic's AI, Claude Sonnet 5.5), directed by sparky-commits1637. The code has not been hand-reviewed and the new features are untested on a device, so please report problems.

### What's new in 1.2.0
- **TalkLoid pitch model.** In **Extract notes**, *Extract pitch curve* now has a **Pitch model** dropdown: RMVPE (as before) or **TalkLoid**, which is built into the app, so nothing extra to install. It was trained on speech, so it suits speech-like audio best.
- **Lyrics from audio (Moonshine).** A new **Transcribe lyrics with Moonshine** option writes English syllables onto the extracted notes in order. It needs the Moonshine tiny model files in the `moonshine-tiny` dependency folder; the checkbox stays off until they are there. English only, and timing is not matched, only order.
- **One Resamplers page.** The two resampler entries in Options are now one **Resamplers** page: the **Catalog** tab downloads ready-made resamplers, and the **My own** tab is the old manager for adding and removing your own files.

### Updating
- Signed with the same key as the previous releases, so it installs over them and keeps your data.
- The package name is unchanged, so it still installs separately from the official OpenUtau Mobile. Android **ARM64** only.
